roster.name: Chapel Perilous
roster.blurb: A first-person grid dungeon crawler set in Illuminatus!-trilogy conspiracy static.

roster.name: Innsmouth 2000
roster.blurb: A Lovecraftian take on the classic 1993 city-builder — zone a rotting coastal town and appease five gods whose wrath is the disasters menu.

roster.name: Stray Squadron
roster.blurb: A browser rail shooter in the format of SNES-era Star Fox, rebuilt as a roguelite with code-generated ships and branching sector runs.

roster.name: Oddseedz
roster.blurb: A cozy, fully code-generated monster-ranching browser toy with 70 Buddies and no death.
